source: Hell Fish: the ultimate 303, not a model of any unit. Schematic factory core with Devil Fish ranges and popular community mods
component_state: factory unit with Devil Fish controls parked at a typical setting
notes: factory.json (schematic) plus mods, chosen for sound: Devil Fish Normal Decay 30 ms - 3 s, Accent Decay 200 ms, Soft Attack 3 ms and 2x Overdrive into the ladder (with the circuit-orientation input pair this growls); self-oscillating resonance in the top ~6 % of the knob (resonance limit 1.12 x critical, feedback ceiling 30), as with the Devil Fish and the x0xb0x R97 mod; a wider Cutoff range (~120 Hz - 2.9 kHz, 4.6 octaves); Env Mod depth x1.4; a bass mod (post-filter HP 40 Hz, oscillator coupling 20 Hz) for a fuller low end; a harder accent (sweep depth 10 oct, VCA depth 2.3) with a 30 ms accent tail. Not representable yet: Filter Tracking, Filter FM, the Muffler, the Accent Sweep speed switch, Slide Time.
